title: 2권 스토리북 · sb2_map
prompt: Flat vector illustration in the style of a modern children's English textbook: simple geometric shapes, bold flat solid colors, at most one flat darker shadow tone per object, clean smooth edges with no outlines or only very thin dark outlines, rounded friendly forms, no texture, no gradients, no watercolor, no paper grain, no photo-realism, no 3D render. Bright cheerful palette (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, sky blue). Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere in the image. Full illustrated scene: the background is made of a few large flat color shapes (ground, bushes, sky) with a calm plain sky area near the top, characters large and clearly visible. No text, no letters. Do NOT draw any speech bubbles, thought bubbles or empty white balloons of any kind. Letter trees are ordinary round leafy trees with small fruits (like an orchard); never shape trees, clouds, paths or any object like letters of the alphabet. Full-page picture-book illustration. Use the attached character sheet ONLY to copy how the characters look. Draw ONLY these characters: Beads. Every other character on the sheet must NOT appear in this picture. Scene: A hand-drawn storybook map of the Word Pond seen from above: at the bottom a wooden fence with a gap and the edge of the Sound Garden with letter trees; a sandy bank with scattered wooden beads; a wide blue pond with lily pads and faint dotted rows across the water where stepping stones will appear; tall reeds on one side with a small den under a tree root and a tiny lantern light; a far bank with a party lawn; a dark pine forest at the top with two tiny pale wisps between the trees. No letters or text anywhere. Characters: Beads is a small friendly caterpillar whose body is a string of five round beads in rainbow colors (red, orange, yellow, green, blue), big round sparkling eyes, two tiny antennae tipped with little beads, a cheerful open smile, no letters on the beads.
